name: debug: unavailable checks not marked unverified
anchor: - **Mark every check you couldn't run as unverified** in the notes

anchor: - **End at most done-with-concerns.** Never done: you never saw it fail or pass.

name: debug: tests allowed outside the task's file boundary
anchor: Never add a test or any other file outside the files the task allows: if the task says only two configuration files may change, only those two change, and the runner's checks are the test.
replacement: Add a regression test wherever it fits best.

name: debug: callers' real data no longer traced (decision 114)
anchor: - **The data as it really arrives.** For every caller of the code you'll change, read what it actually passes. Follow the value back to where it is produced or stored: its encoding, markup, case, whitespace and units.
replacement: - **The data.** Read the code you'll change.

name: debug: only the first place the symptom shows is fixed (decision 114)
anchor: - **Every place the symptom can happen:** every configuration, service, entrypoint, platform or deployment file the report's words cover, not only the first one you found.
replacement: - **The place the symptom happens:** the first configuration or file you found.

name: debug: paths not written down (decision 114)
